blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Air Force (PAF) on Tuesday defended the condition of its SF-260 training aircraft following a midair collision in Batangas that killed four pilots, saying the planes remained within their prescribed operating hours despite being more than a decade old. PAF spokesperson Col. Alvin Jay Capinguian said the aircraft, acquired brand-new between 2010 and 2011, still had several years of service life left. “In aviation, we’d like to dispel the notion of katandaan (old age),” Capinguian said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City.
